# remote_directory_tool

> List directory contents on a remote code workspace via SSH.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=remote_directory_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List directory contents on a remote code workspace via SSH.

Lists files in a directory, optionally recursive. Respects the workspace's
file_patterns_exclude configuration to filter out noise (node_modules, .git, etc.).

EXAMPLES:

List all files recursively:
{workspace_slug: "my-project"}

List a specific directory non-recursively:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", path: "app/models", recursive: false}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_slug` | string | yes | Workspace slug identifying which remote server to connect to. |
| `path` | string | no | Relative directory path (default: workspace root ".") |
| `recursive` | boolean | no | List files recursively (default: true) |
